name: Answer customer questions from the business's own knowledge
summary: Answers customer questions from the business's own help content: a published Front knowledge base article or a Gorgias macro. Crons read, match and queue each reply; a person approves every reply before it is sent. Sensitive questions and anything the business's own answers do not cover go to a person.

covered_by.question-received: intake (polls every 10 minutes; no webhook yet)
covered_by.look-up-answer: draft (published article or macro only); judgment answers are the agent skill
covered_by.escalate: draft (assign in Front, tag in Gorgias)

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: New open questions from Front's shared inbox and Gorgias tickets, within the lookback window.

crons.name: draft
crons.summary: Escalate sensitive questions, queue answers from the business's own articles and macros for approval, park the rest.

crons.name: chase
crons.summary: Remind the teammate in Front about a question still waiting after the chase window.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: reads, an assignee or reminder inside Front, a tag inside Gorgias. Sending a reply is a live operation and waits for a person.

front.covers: shared inbox: read open unassigned conversations and the latest customer message, answer from a published knowledge base article after approval, assign to the teammate, reminder on a waiting question

gorgias.covers: helpdesk tickets: read open tickets and the latest customer message, answer from a macro's response text after approval, tag a ticket for a person

gaps: Intercom: named in the platform evidence, but no operations are mapped for it in the kit, so there is no adapter. Its help-centre pages do not show the API steps.
Zendesk: mapped in the kit, but no platform help evidence was read for this job, so no adapter.
Chat widgets and the overflow service: a chat widget answers FAQs on the website and is not a platform the kit reads; the overflow service is a person, so it stays out of the automatic path.

Judgment answers: a question no answer rule covers is parked, and the agent skill writes the reply. The kit has no proposal step for helpdesk replies yet, so a reply the agent writes goes through the platform's own draft, then a person sends it.
Gorgias: the ops file has no draft-reply or close operation, so every Gorgias reply waits in the approval queue, and the ticket is not closed by this workflow.

Gorgias macros with template variables such as {{ticket.customer.firstname}} are not sent, because the API does not fill those variables in. Such a macro needs a plain-text copy, or the answer rule should point to a Front article.
Front: closing or archiving a conversation after an answer is not built. Front can do it, but the status change reaches the customer's thread and needs a person for now.
Record-keeping: each enquiry is kept in the workflow's own store with its status and approval. No note is written back to the customer record in either platform yet.
Follow-up after a sent answer (for example, asking whether it helped) is not built. Only waiting questions get a reminder.

Intake polls every 10 minutes and reads only the first page of each platform's list. There is no webhook, so a message can wait up to 10 minutes. A busy inbox over 25 conversations needs paging added.

Both adapters are docs-only until a sandbox account (a Front trial inbox, a Gorgias trial account) proves the reads and writes. Front's help pages describe its inbox at a high level only, so its reply screens are unverified.
Gorgias reply receiver and channel values are taken from the ticket and the vendor's create-message schema, and have not been run against a live account.
